data.title: Data

ApplicationPatch.description: Stage is changed with POST /applications/{id}/move, not here.
ApplicationPatch.title: ApplicationPatch

ApplicationRow.description: An application with the names the list and board need.
ApplicationRow.title: ApplicationRow

AttachmentPatch.description: Rename a file (its display name; the file on disk keeps its path) or move it to something else.
AttachmentPatch.title: AttachmentPatch

ContactSummary.description: Everything about one person: who they are and what they've been part of.
ContactSummary.title: ContactSummary

CvFile.description:
A file that looks like a CV, attached to applications, roles or people: one per distinct
file (by content).
CvFile.title: CvFile

CvFileAdopt.description:
Make a file a version of a document (an existing one, or a new one named here), or, when
it already is one, record it as sent with the applications it's attached to.
CvFileAdopt.title: CvFileAdopt

DocumentUsage.description: One application a version of this document was sent with.
DocumentUsage.title: DocumentUsage

DuplicateOut.description: Another application that looks like the same job: same company, same or similar title.
DuplicateOut.title: DuplicateOut

ErrorOut.description:
An error's body. Only `detail` is always there: `code` and `params` come with coded errors.
`detail` is English text, or for the framework's own 422 a list of problems.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

InterviewIn.description: An interview round. Leave `round` out to make it the next round for the application.
InterviewIn.title: InterviewIn

LinkIn.description: An external link (a Google Doc, the job ad, a repo…) on something. Title defaults from the URL.
LinkIn.title: LinkIn

MeetingIn.description: A call or meeting with a person. Book one ahead (`scheduled`) or log one you've had (`done`).
MeetingIn.title: MeetingIn

NoteIn.description: A Markdown note. `links` attach it to things, e.g. ["application:<id>"]; none makes it a general note.
NoteIn.title: NoteIn

OfferIn.description: An offer on an application. Money is whole units of `currency` a year, except `day_rate`.
OfferIn.title: OfferIn

QuickApplicationIn.description:
Create an application and, in the same transaction, anything it needs that doesn't exist yet.

Company, agency and recruiter can each be given by id or by name. A name that matches an
existing record (case-insensitively) reuses it; otherwise a new one is created. A recruiter
name is matched within the application's agency.
QuickApplicationIn.title: QuickApplicationIn

RoleSummary.description: A role with where it came from and where it stands: still to decide, applied, or passed.
RoleSummary.title: RoleSummary

RoundSummary.description: The round an application is at, for the board and list: "Round 2 · System design test".
RoundSummary.title: RoundSummary

SentDocumentOut.description: A document version sent with an application.
SentDocumentOut.title: SentDocumentOut

TodoIn.description:
A to-do in your own words. Leave `entity_type` and `entity_id` out for one about nothing in
particular, or give both to put it on a company, agency, person, role or application.
TodoIn.title: TodoIn

TodoPatch.description: `done: true` ticks it off (stamping `done_at`); `done: false` brings it back.
TodoPatch.title: TodoPatch

ValidationIssue.description: One problem in the framework's own 422.
ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue
